caption: The drawing depicts a single cow, rendered in grayscale pencil on a cream-colored background. The cow is shown in profile, facing to the right, and is detailed with shading to indicate musculature and contours of the body. The cow stands on a horizontal bar that runs the length of its body, with an additional vertical bar extending downward from this base, and another vertical line extending upward from the horizontal bar near the back legs, giving the appearance that the cow is supported on a stand. The drawing is enclosed within a rectangular border, and there is a faint scale near the lower center of the image, marked with increments. The artist's name, "Salvatore Borrazzo," is written in small text at the lower left corner of the border. There is a small, light stamp or watermark in the upper left corner of the image. The entire composition is monochromatic, utilizing a range of pencil grays, and the background is left mostly blank.
title: Weather Vane Finial
